checks.detail: Two independent host builds from the frozen candidate (replay 60ad39c8, capture_evidence ebe69cae) pass every blocking check: fresh build, source_unchanged, native_candidate_matches, embedded assets, product UI separation, session/window/renderer, and a replay interaction with a real inline validation delta. White-box lanes pass: tsc, vite build, cargo fmt --check, cargo check, rust-unit 50/50 covering auth boundaries (private operations reject without session, generic rate-limited failures, single-use/expired/reused link tokens), persistence (register_verify_signin_quickadd_restart_persists), and deeplink scheme registration. Security: Tauri capabilities least-privilege (core:event:default only) and mail-sink receipts redact content/tokens. Visual: multimodal review of six signed-in surfaces plus auth and journey captures against PRD 9.1 holds the direction — editorial neutral canvas, restrained amber accent, thin rules, icon+text nav, light structural board columns, month+agenda calendar, no prohibited patterns; Settings shows reminder delivery states with test-email action (PRD 7; 9.2 email-settings third verified). Every journey-manifest selector and string was verified present in shipped source, including dynamic nav-<id> testids and the App.tsx:387 notice. Carried gaps (external deeplink activation, 9.2 fault/narrow captures) are evidence-lane debt recorded as findings, not product defects.

White-box layer fully proven: rust-unit 50/50 in the fresh receipt includes golden_path_section3_self_drive, register_verify_signin_quickadd_restart_persists, and token parsing/single-use/expiry/reuse recovery. Black-box layer advanced this loop: a new host-collected, manifest-consuming journey_drive drove real WebDriver steps — landing shell, create-account, and registration to check-your-email all pass with verified postconditions and bound screenshots; the anonymous smoke shows a genuine validation delta; and six signed-in surfaces captured across two independent drives display the journey end-states (completed task row, focus history Completed, reminder SENT with delivery state, '1 task completed.' summary). The drive then stopped at step 4 on a collector-side mail_kind_equals defect: the receipt itself classifies the record kind=verification with matching to and subject, yet the check fails against redacted content, and the sink record format (mail.rs MailMessage) has no kind field. That is measurement infrastructure, recorded as fnd.loop24.journey-mail-kind-postcondition-unsatisfiable; no product behavior contradicts the PRD anywhere evidence exists. Exact unverified outcomes: the host-driven signed-in create-task/focus/reminder/sign-out-sign-in persistence pass and the four recovery states remain unverified by the independent lane; focus running/paused mid-transitions, exact-once count, and the project-assignment select value are unasserted predicates (see coverage finding). Verdict pass with carried evidence-lane debt; no product defect observed.
